## Domain analysis and decisions

### Business outcome and scope (`business_outcome`)

State the business capabilities, decisions, and boundaries the architecture must support.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Current-state evidence (`current_state`)

Describe systems, flows, ownership, and known problems with evidence dates.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Principles and requirements (`principles`)

Distinguish mandatory constraints from negotiable design preferences.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Target architecture (`target_state`)

Describe target capabilities, data boundaries, interfaces, governance, and operations ownership.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Transition architecture (`transition`)

Define deliverable interim states, migration order, and compatibility measures.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Key decisions and trade-offs (`tradeoffs`)

Record alternatives, trade-offs, approval roles, and triggers for revisiting decisions.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Conformance and acceptance (`conformance`)

List standards, exceptions, tests, and view-review evidence.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Dependency roadmap (`roadmap`)

Map capability and data dependencies to gates and verifiable exits.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.
